learning_outcomes.text: Identify the types of earthworks site (small mass, large mass).
Choose the material (site machinery), human and financial resources in accordance with current legislation (town planning, road transport, etc.).
Study all types of earthworks, while complying with the administrative, environmental (climate change, LCA) and technical constraints of any project.
Know the main types of earthworks, with an understanding of the associated environmental impact.
Know and choose earthmoving machinery in accordance with the technical and economic constraints of a site.
Classify materials and aggregates in accordance with regulatory guides.
Prepare an earthworks site and declare any type of work near a network (D.I.C.T., A.I.P.R.).

syllabus_topics: Basic concepts (platform, polluted site, natural ground)
Small-scale earthworks (excavations, backfill adjacent to structures)
Large-scale earthworks (roads, motorways, industrial platforms, stadiums, hospitals, logistics centres, railway platforms)
Common machinery (hydraulic shovel, dumper, articulated dumper, bulldozer, grader, scaper, compactor)
Road transport legislation (2 to several axles)
Earthworks, from design to acceptance of work
Technical studies (classification of materials, season/weather, environmental and economic constraints, regulatory references, DICT)
Planning and phasing (movement of earth, cubic metres, longitudinal profiles)
Carrying out the work (machinery, type of movements, soil treatment, adjustment and compaction)
Visit to an earthworks site (4h TD) in progress in Occitanie.
assessment_rules: The evaluation formula is based entirely on Continuous Control (CC1).
